commands.install_python: python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install flask flask-cors  # nuts_calc_tex.py itself needs no pip packages, only pdflatex/lualatex on PATH
commands.run_cli: cd backend && python3 nuts_calc_tex.py <paper_size> <command> [options]  # requires lualatex (default) or pdflatex selected via NUTS_CALC_TEX_ENGINE

notes.package_manager: No requirements.txt/pyproject.toml/setup.py exists for the Python side (a prior setup.py was removed per commit d9fc0a3, verified: 'git log -- backend/nuts_calc.py', when nuts_calc.py itself still existed pre-#232). README.md's Setup/Dependencies sections describe installing Flask/Flask-Cors manually via pip; nuts_calc_tex.py itself (the sole CLI since issue #232 removed nuts_calc.py/reportlab) has zero pip dependencies, only pdflatex/lualatex on PATH. frontend/web has its own independent package.json/package-lock.json for npm (frontend/spa, its former sibling, was removed in issue #233).
notes.ci: No .github/workflows directory or other CI definition exists in this repo (verified: 'find .github -type f' returns nothing).
notes.restructure_issue_88: The repo was reorganized in issue #88 from a web/{backend,frontend} layout to backend/ + frontend/{spa,web}. frontend/spa was removed in issue #233, leaving frontend/web as the sole Web UI. The former backend/renderers.py was renamed to backend/renderer_config.py in issue #297 when its CLI/subprocess functions were deleted; it now contains renderer-name resolution and the shared RendererRequest type.
notes.tests: backend/tests/ contains 34 Python test_*.py files (backend/pytest.ini: testpaths=tests, pythonpath=., addopts=-n auto); all 1107 tests passed on 2026-09-02, including available pdflatex/lualatex-gated tests. frontend/web has 3 node:test files (72 tests total, including vite.config.test.js); all passed when invoked explicitly. It defines no npm test script.
notes.known_defects: frontend/web has no lint script configured. (frontend/spa formerly had one known no-irregular-whitespace lint failure in drillPresets.js; moot since frontend/spa was removed in issue #233.)
notes.nuts_calc_tex_py: The sole PDF-generation CLI/renderer since issue #232 removed nuts_calc.py (ReportLab). It implements 20 commands and requires lualatex (default) or pdflatex. POST /generate-pdf routes every recognized command through backend/three_layer_renderer.py in-process; issue #297 deleted the legacy CLI/subprocess path and renamed backend/renderers.py to backend/renderer_config.py.
notes.generate_problems_endpoint: backend/app.py exposes a third endpoint, POST /generate-problems (issue #138), alongside POST /generate-pdf and GET /renderer-info. It accepts paper_size/command_type/num and returns JSON problem data without generating a PDF, by calling backend/problem_generation.py's in-process wrappers around nuts_calc_tex.py's data-generation functions (no subprocess). It supports all 20 command types: 19 use the {'problems': [...]} envelope and 100 uses the dedicated {'table': {...}} envelope added in issue #228. frontend/web's preset.html detail screen (frontend/web/src/presetDetail.js, issue #139/#177) uses it to replace static example chips with live-generated ones for eligible ope variants, debounced 300ms; the former frontend/spa (removed in issue #233) never used this endpoint. See docs/L3_implementation/api.md.
